title: How was {event}? 4 minutes to decide what we keep next time
description: A short feedback survey for everyone who registered for {event}, our virtual developer conference.
audience: People who registered for {event} (about 300 developers), whether they watched live or on recording
purpose: Decide which session types to keep or drop, and whether to run {event} again next year

welcome.title: How was {event}?
welcome.description:
Thanks for joining us. We're the organising team, and your answers decide which sessions we keep, which we drop, and whether we run {event} again.
• For everyone who registered, live or on recording
• Takes about 4 minutes
• Anonymous: we only look at answers in summary
• Voluntary: you can stop at any time
• Open until {date}. Questions? {contact}

thank_you.title: Thank you, that helps a lot
thank_you.description: We'll email every registrant a summary of the feedback and our decision about next year by {date}. Questions? {contact}
